Round-trip: Stage 1 → generated text → Stage 2

STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: mg_07857_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: mg_07857_combined.v · Open raw
module mg_07857(dout, full, empty,clk, rst_n, clr, din, we, re);
input clk, rst_n; 
 input clr; 
 input [7:0] din; 
 input we; 
 output [7:0] dout; 
 input re; 
 output full, empty; 
 reg [7:0] mem[0:3]; 
 reg [1:0] wp; 
 reg [1:0] rp; 
 wire [1:0] wp_p1; 
 wire [1:0] rp_p1; 
 wire full, empty; 
 reg gb; 
 always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) 
  if(!rst_n) wp <= 2'h0; 
  else 
  if(clr) wp <= 2'h0; 
  else 
  if(we) wp <= wp_p1; 
 assign wp_p1 = wp + 2'h1; 
 always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) 
  if(!rst_n) rp <= 2'h0; 
  else 
  if(clr) rp <= 2'h0; 
  else 
  if(re) rp <= rp_p1; 
 assign rp_p1 = rp + 2'h1; 
 assign dout = mem[ rp ]; 
 always @(posedge clk) 
  if(we) mem[ wp ] <= din; 
 assign empty = (wp == rp) & !gb; 
 assign full = (wp == rp) & gb; 
 always @(posedge clk) 
  if(!rst_n) gb <= 1'b0; 
  else 
  if(clr) gb <= 1'b0; 
  else 
  if((wp_p1 == rp) & we) gb <= 1'b1; 
  else 
  if(re) gb <= 1'b0; 
 endmodule
STAGE 2

Generate the module

InputThe generated Stage 1 specification plus the required top-module name mg_07857.
InstructionImplement the complete synthesizable RTL module from the generated specification.

Protocol summary; the Stage 2 runner creates a fresh prompt.

Stage 1 output → abstraction gate → fresh Stage 2 input. The intermediate text is generated separately for each model/attempt. It is not a prefilled golden description. Stage 2 receives neither the clean RTL nor the Stage 1 conversation.
